subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should OpenResponses `input_file` support durable Excel and generic binary workspace receipts in core, and what security/persistence contract should that public API expose?
rationale: A correct fix affects public Gateway API behavior, MIME/default policy, URL fetch security, persistence, transcript redaction, and tool-access boundaries, so automation should not choose the contract alone.

options.title: Design a Gateway receipt contract
options.body: Add a core binary staging contract for explicitly allowed MIME types, sanitized metadata, byte limits, redaction behavior, and tool-visible receipts before implementation.

options.title: Keep extraction-only input_file
options.body: Limit `/v1/responses` `input_file` to current text/PDF extraction and route Excel/binary workflows through existing chat attachment offload or plugins.

options.title: Track provider-native forwarding separately
options.body: Leave this issue focused on local workspace receipts and use the related provider-native forwarding issue for model file input passthrough.

recommendation.title: Design a Gateway receipt contract
recommendation.body: Add a core binary staging contract for explicitly allowed MIME types, sanitized metadata, byte limits, redaction behavior, and tool-visible receipts before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The central current behavior comes from the shared OpenResponses input handling and limit-resolution commits, and this account was already pulled into the issue discussion.
